description: Rename a folder, move it under a different parent, or both. Pass parentId: null to move it back to the top level. A folder cannot be moved inside itself or its own subfolders.

folderId.description: Folder id (uuid) as returned by list_storage or create_folder

name.description: New name (omit to keep the current one)

parentId.description: New parent folder id, or null for top level. Omit to leave the parent unchanged.

name: update_folder
title: Rename or Move Folder
